descriptionHtml:
Fantech Kanata S WG9S Dual-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse - Black (12000 DPI)

Unleash high-tier competitive gaming speed and absolute tracking accuracy with the Fantech Kanata S WG9S Dual-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse. Now available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance gaming hardware peripheral is custom-built for competitive esports players, FPS enthusiasts, and marathon PC gamers across Egypt who demand pro-grade latency-free freedom, lightweight handling agility, and a stable setup workspace configuration.

The Fantech Kanata S WG9S features advanced Dual-Mode connectivity, enabling effortless swapping between hyper-fast StrikeSpeed 2.4GHz wireless tracking for zero-lag gameplay execution and a secure USB-C wired charging layout. Powered by the premium Pixart 3311 gaming optical sensor, it delivers flawless aiming precision up to 12,000 DPI, 300 IPS maximum speed, and 35G acceleration system layouts. Outfitted with heavy-duty Huano Blue Shell White Dot mechanical switches rated for 20 million clicks, it ensures maximum feedback click durability.
